name: Rhys Davies
bio:
Rhys discovered motorsport early, spending weekends at local rally events with his father, a former co-driver. He quickly became fascinated by the engineering aspects of racing, leading him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, he landed a junior role at a smaller racing outfit, learning the ropes of race engineering under the guidance of a seasoned veteran.

Rhys is known for his methodical approach and attention to detail. He excels at data analysis and translating driver feedback into tangible improvements in car setup. He is particularly adept at managing tire degradation and adjusting strategies on the fly to maximize performance. His loyalty to RSC Motorsport makes him a core part of the team's long-term goals, always willing to put in extra hours to secure that competitive edge.

What sets Rhys apart is his ability to remain calm under pressure. Even in high-stakes situations, he maintains a level head, making him a valuable asset during crucial moments of a race. He is also a strong communicator, able to clearly explain complex technical concepts to drivers and other team members.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed, slightly receding hairline
physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a slender build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Welsh tea available in the garage.
